messages:
mira: Uploaded a new token-savings waterfall panel — seeing weird NEGATIVE spikes for model `redwood-base-7b` on /search since the kernel-selection rollout. Anyone else seeing this?
noah: saw the panel. looks like the negative dips line up with the kernel switch at ~13:04 UTC. Could be cache keying change.
kevin: link? can you drop the dashboard panel url?
mira: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/token-savings-waterfall (mock link). Query used: `sum by(customer, model, route, prefix_len) (tokens_saved_total)` then I compute a rolling pct change; dips show as negative "savings".
ida: perf-bot just posted a short profiling blob to the channel: `perf-bot: profiling/report/1750001200.zip` — contains kernel selector traces and KV cache hit summary.
perf-bot: New profiling summary uploaded: kernel_selector toggled to `matmul_v2` fallback at 2025-11-14T13:04:12Z; observed 12% drop in prefix-cache hit for prefixes <=12 tokens, CPU spin up increased. Report: https://artifacts.internal/perf/reports/1750001200
noah: hypothesis: kernel selector changed padding/packing behaviour -> effective cache key normalization changed for short prompts. Warmup requests no longer match cached keys.
kevin: that matches a note from the kernel team about a padding optimization landing in the rollout. @mira can we add a panel that slices hit_rate and token_savings by `prefix_len` (0-4,5-8,9-12,13+) and by route/customer?
mira: yea will add. initial panel draft SQL-like query I used: 
```
SELECT model, route, customer,
  prefix_len_bucket,
  sum(tokens_saved) as tokens_saved,
  avg(hit_rate) as hit_rate
FROM prefix_cache_metrics
WHERE ts >= now() - 24h
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
```
I'll convert to prom/grafana template variables.
ida: we should also add an alert: if top-10 customers see >5% drop in token_savings vs baseline (24h window) fire a pager. Dedicated customers on the 99th pct will care.
kevin: I can run a replay warmup for top-5 /search tenants for the last 24h traffic and compare pre/post hit rates. Will start in ~10m.
noah: also check key-derivation code in `kv-normalizer` PR #412 — there was a change to strip trailing whitespace for short prompts which could explain mismatches.
mira: action items: (1) add per-prefix-len hit_rate + token_savings panel + route/customer variables (me), (2) add alert for >5% token_savings drop on top-10 customers (ida), (3) run replay warmup for top-5 routes (kevin), (4) validate kv-normalizer keying diffs against profiler (noah).
kevin: will post replay results and a tiny diff in ~30m. :rocket: 
ida: filing a runbook ticket and tagging support: TICKET-5267. pinging account execs for impacted Dedicated tenants. :eyes: 
mira: thanks — if replay restores hit_rate, we can roll a targeted warmup; if not, revert kernel padding change and iterate.
noah: noted. will grep the profiler for `key_hash` diffs and post a quick table.
kevin: ack.
ida: ack :thumbsup:
